page.layout: One page of text in verse, with a running head at the top; a short heading ("Sara. Abrahamus.") and a second heading ("SARA.") with its verse; a partly visible line at the bottom right; faint marginal show-through and stains only, no notes.

p.i: Volucris ecce fluxerant iam iam mihi
Ter fena lustra aui, atque originem in clyta,
Sed nobiles proauos habentem quid iuuat
Magnósque honores, si Patris summi loco,
Hac ergo despexi, meis simul tua
Promissa qua me rura Velles Visere.
Verum lubens quicunque te sequitur ducem
Quoties memori renoluo corde quot bona
Sis Vsque largitus mihi, ter Optime
Seu me laborum coniugis certam pij

page.notes: Faint show-through and stains throughout; the final line is cut off at the page edge and partly illegible. Several letters in the verse are blurred, so the italic readings are approximate.
